hook_line: GOLDMAN SACHS UPGRADES INDIA TO OVERWEIGHT, SETS NIFTY TARGET OF 28,500

hook_stat.sub: Nifty target by end-2027 set by Goldman Sachs

stats.label: Upside implied by the 28,500 target from current levels
Nifty earnings-per-share growth forecast for both 2027 and 2028
Cumulative foreign investor selloff from India between 2024 and 2026

diaspora_bullets: Goldman favours domestic-facing cyclicals over the export-heavy IT names in many NRI portfolios
Goldman is overweight banks, defence, utilities, telecom and internet stocks
news_summary: Goldman Sachs upgraded Indian equities to overweight in its Asia-Pacific portfolio strategy and set a Nifty target of 28,500 by end-2027, implying roughly 12 percent upside from current levels.
payoff: The 28,500 target is a forecast, not a result, and rests on 15% earnings growth in 2027 and 2028.
